content: 1. Elagolix Dosage and Duration: Administer 5 mg orally in the morning, followed by one 300 mg capsule of elagolix orally in the evening. The treatment duration should not exceed 24 months due to the risk of irreversible bone loss. Pregnancy must be excluded before starting treatment or initiated within 7 days of the onset of menstruation. 2. Drug Interactions with Elagolix: Ceftobiprole Medocaril Sodium: Increases elagolix levels via OATP1B1/1B3 inhibition. Concomitant use is contraindicated. Clotrimazole: Increases elagolix levels. Concomitant use is contraindicated. Cyclosporine: Increases elagolix levels. Concomitant use is contraindicated. Encorafenib: Increases elagolix levels. Concomitant use is contraindicated. Erythromycin (various forms): Increases elagolix levels. Concomitant use is contraindicated. Gemfibrozil: Increases elagolix levels. Concomitant use is contraindicated. Glecaprevir/Pibrentasvir: Increases elagolix levels. Concomitant use is contraindicated. Lenvatinib: Increases elagolix levels. Concomitant use is contraindicated. Lonafarnib: Elagolix decreases lonafarnib levels by affecting CYP3A4 metabolism. Concomitant use is contraindicated. Mavacamten: Elagolix decreases mavacamten levels via CYP3A4 metabolism. Concomitant use is contraindicated. Ombitasvir/Paritaprevir/Ritonavir & Dasabuvir: Increases elagolix levels. Concomitant use is contraindicated. Pazopanib: Increases elagolix levels. Concomitant use is contraindicated. Ritonavir: Increases elagolix levels. Concomitant use is contraindicated. Tacrolimus: Increases elagolix levels. Concomitant use is contraindicated. Telmisartan: Increases elagolix levels. Concomitant use is contraindicated. 3. Contraceptive Interactions: Acitretin: Reduces the effectiveness of norethindrone acetate, potentially leading to contraceptive failure. Concomitant use is contraindicated. Apalutamide: Reduces norethindrone acetate levels via CYP3A4 metabolism. Avoid or use an alternative drug. Belzutifan: Reduces norethindrone acetate levels and may cause contraceptive failure. Use effective non-hormonal contraception. Carbamazepine: Reduces norethindrone acetate levels. Avoid or use an alternative drug. Dienogest/Estradiol Valerate: Reduces elagolix efficacy due to pharmacodynamic antagonism. Avoid or use an alternative drug. Ethinylestradiol: Reduces elagolix efficacy. Avoid or use an alternative drug. Fexinidazole: Increases norethindrone acetate and elagolix levels via CYP3A4 inhibition. Avoid or use an alternative drug. Fosphenytoin: Reduces norethindrone acetate levels. Avoid or use an alternative drug. Levonorgestrel (various forms): Reduces elagolix efficacy. Avoid or use an alternative drug. Mestranol: Reduces elagolix efficacy. Avoid or use an alternative drug. Mitotane: Reduces norethindrone acetate levels. Avoid or use an alternative drug. Phenobarbital: Reduces norethindrone acetate levels. Avoid or use an alternative drug. Phenytoin: Reduces norethindrone acetate levels. Avoid or use an alternative drug. Primidone: Reduces norethindrone acetate levels. Avoid or use an alternative drug. Rifabutin: Reduces norethindrone acetate levels. Avoid or use an alternative drug. Rifampin: Reduces norethindrone acetate levels. Avoid or use an alternative drug. Rifapentine: Reduces norethindrone acetate levels. Avoid or use an alternative drug. 4. Other Drug Interactions: Abemaciclib: Elagolix reduces abemaciclib levels via CYP3A4 metabolism. Monitor closely and adjust therapy as needed. Acalabrutinib: Elagolix reduces acalabrutinib levels. Monitor closely and adjust therapy as needed. Afatinib: Elagolix increases afatinib levels via P-glycoprotein inhibition. Use caution and monitor. Albiglutide: Norethindrone acetate reduces albiglutide effects. Monitor glycemic control in diabetic patients. Alfentanil: Elagolix reduces alfentanil levels. Monitor closely and adjust therapy as needed. Alfuzosin: Elagolix reduces alfuzosin levels. Monitor closely and adjust therapy as needed. Aliskiren: Elagolix increases aliskiren levels via P-glycoprotein inhibition. Use caution and monitor. Alpelisib: Elagolix reduces alpelisib levels. Monitor closely and adjust therapy as needed. 5. General Recommendations: Elagolix is a weak-to-moderate CYP3A4 inducer. Monitor CYP3A substrates when co-administered and consider dose adjustments if necessary. Women using elagolix should use non-hormonal contraception during treatment and for one week after discontinuation to avoid contraceptive failure. This summary provides a detailed explanation of the interactions and recommendations for elagolix and other medications.
